subject: BCP / RTO-RPO evidence + live witness for ClearPay SOC2/SIG
messages:
From: Ellie Park <ellie.park@clearpay.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wade <twade@clearpay.com>, Lucent Audit SOC2 <soc2-audits@lucentaudit.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: RTO/RPO evidence + witness (SOC2/SIG)

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the quick introductions yesterday. ClearPay's security team is compiling the SOC2 / SIG evidence packet and we need a short BCP/DR supplement from Redwood. Specifically could you provide:

- A concise RTO and RPO statement per service (API generation, embeddings, metadata indexing) with last test timestamps.
- Sample restore logs showing start/end timestamps for at least one full recovery (include which artifacts were restored).
- Chain-of-custody notes for encrypted backups and where keys are stored during restore.
- A short (15–30 minute) live witness session where an ops engineer walks a Lucent auditor through a restore log and confirms cache warm-up behavior (KV warm-up) — ideally week of 2026-04-05.

We prefer remote witness (Zoom + screen share). Please confirm what artifacts you can share ahead of the call and any account/drive links we should expect.

Appreciate a reply with an estimated delivery date and names of the Redwood point people.

Best,
Ellie Park
Security Program Manager
ClearPay Financial
[Attachment: SOC2-ask-checklist.xlsx (xls)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Park <ellie.park@clearpay.com>
Cc: Tom Wade <twade@clearpay.com>, Lucent Audit SOC2 <soc2-audits@lucentaudit.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence + witness (SOC2/SIG)

Hi Ellie —

Thanks for the clear checklist. We can provide the artifacts you requested and run the remote witness walkthrough during the week you suggested. Summary plan below:

- Deliverables (by 2026-03-27): concise per-service RTO/RPO table, one anonymized restore log (timestamps + file list), and a short chain-of-custody narrative for backup keys.
- Ops witness slot: propose 2026-04-06 10:00–10:30 PT (we can shift by an hour if needed).
- Witness format: Zoom + screen-share, live console access read-only. We will record for internal audit only; we can provide a recording copy if Lucent needs it.

I'll loop in Dev (Cloud Reliability) and Marissa (Compliance ops) to assemble artifacts and confirm the S3 snapshot export. Dev / Marissa — can you confirm the availability of the RPO timelogs and whether we can sanitize customer IDs in the restore trace? Also flag any reasons we should prefer a later witness date.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_bcp_summary_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: ClearPay RPO artifacts — action items

Stephanie / Marissa —

I'll own artifact assembly. Quick operational notes and blockers:

1) RPO/RTO table: we can produce a per-service RTO/RPO statement. Current committed RTOs: API generation 15 min (warm caches), embeddings indexing 60 min (cold restore path), metadata index 30 min. RPOs: API generation 0s for in-flight KV; embeddings 5 min; metadata 1 min. (I will export the official matrix from ops runbook).

2) Restore logs: we have a full restore run from 2026-02-10 that includes start/end timestamps, object checksums, and verification steps. That can be sanitized and exported as rpo-timelogs-202603.zip.

3) Chain-of-custody: backups are encrypted with a customer-agnostic KMS key; key metadata and access rotation notes live in the compliance vault. Need Marissa to redact key ARNs and produce a narrative that satisfies SIG CAI sections on encrypted backups.

4) Witness: For the witness we will perform a focused demo of the restore log and a KV warm-up trace (showing request tail-latency drop as cache warms). Ops prefers 2026-04-06 10:00 PT. I will provision a read-only sandbox and a time-limited console account.

Blocking: I need confirmation on whether to include non-prod trace ids in logs (we should strip PII). Also need Marissa to sign off on the sanitized package.

Action owners: Dev (assembly + sandbox), Marissa (redaction & sign-off), Stephanie (external scheduling). ETA: artifacts ready 2026-03-27 EOD.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Cloud Reliability Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runbook-v2.md (stub)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-23T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: ClearPay RPO artifacts — action items

All —

Confirmed. I will redact PII and remove any customer identifiers from the restore logs. Deliverables and status:

- Sanctioned artifacts (will drop to Drive and provide links): redwood_bcp_summary_v1.pdf, rpo-timelogs-202603.zip (sanitized), chain-of-custody-narrative.txt.
- Witness invite: created and attached (witness-invite-ics.ics).
- Compliance sign-off: I will produce a short attestation note for Lucent stating that artifacts are redacted per our policy.

If Ellie prefers a different time, we can slide to 2026-04-06 11:00 PT; ops sandbox will still be available.

Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: chain-of-custody-narrative.txt (txt)]

From: Ellie Park <ellie.park@clearpay.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wade <twade@clearpay.com>, Lucent Audit SOC2 <soc2-audits@lucentaudit.com>
Date: 2026-03-24T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence + witness (SOC2/SIG)

Thanks everyone — that plan works.

Please send the Drive links and the witness invite when ready. We confirm the 2026-04-06 10:00 PT slot for a 25-minute walkthrough (Ellie + Tom + one Lucent auditor). We will send any NDA/POA if needed prior to the session but don't expect it to block the demo.

One ask before the walkthrough: can you include a 1–2 sentence description in the packet that explains how KV warm-up reduces tail latency (we'll include that in the SIG evidence sheet).

Appreciate the responsiveness.

Best,
Ellie Park
Security Program Manager
ClearPay Financial
